subject: general
question: A large cube is formed by melting of three smaller cubes of sides 3 cm, 4 cm and 5 cm each. The ratio of the surface areas of the three smaller cubes together to the larger cube is:
solution:
**Given:**

Side of the first cube = 3 cm

Side of the second cube = 4 cm

Side of the third cube = 5 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a cube = side³

Surface area of a cube = 6 × side²

**Calculation:**

Volume of the first cube = 3³ = 27 cm³

Volume of the second cube = 4³ = 64 cm³

Volume of the third cube = 5³ = 125 cm³

Total Volume of the three smaller cubes = 27 + 64 + 125 = 216 cm³

Volume of the larger cube = 216 cm³

Side of the larger cube = ∛(216) = 6 cm

Surface area of the first cube = 6 × 3² = 54 cm²

Surface area of the second cube = 6 × 4² = 96 cm²

Surface area of the third cube = 6 × 5² = 150 cm²

Total surface area of the three smaller cubes = 54 + 96 + 150 = 300 cm²

Surface area of the larger cube = 6 × 6² = 216 cm²

Ratio of the surface areas of the three smaller cubes together to the larger cube = 300 / 216

Simplifying the ratio:

300 / 216 = 25 / 18

**The ratio of the surface areas of the three smaller cubes together to the larger cube is 25 : 18.**
